title: RouteWarden Configuration
description: JSON schema for RouteWarden HTTP security middleware (Traefik, Caddy, NGINX / OpenResty).

configFile.description: Path to a routewarden.json base configuration file. Inline options override file values.

config_file.description: Path to a routewarden.json base configuration file (snake_case alias). Inline options override file values.

enabled.description: Master switch to enable or bypass RouteWarden inspection.

enableDefaultPatterns.description: Enable built-in sensitive path patterns (.env, .git, .aws, keys, credentials, db dumps, actuator, container configs, wp-config, etc.).

enable_default_patterns.description: Enable built-in sensitive path patterns (snake_case alias).

blockPatterns.description: Custom regular expressions for paths to block.

block_patterns.description: Custom regular expressions for paths to block (snake_case alias).

allowPatterns.description: Whitelisted regular expressions that take precedence over block patterns.

allowedIps.description: List of client IP addresses or CIDR blocks exempted from all security rules.

allowed_ips.description: List of client IP addresses or CIDR blocks exempted from all security rules (snake_case alias).

trustedProxies.description: List of trusted upstream reverse proxies or CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For headers are honoured.

trusted_proxies.description: List of trusted upstream reverse proxies or CIDRs (snake_case alias).

methods.description: HTTP request methods to inspect (e.g. GET, POST, HEAD, PUT, DELETE).

checkQuery.description: Inspect URL query strings and individual query parameters against block patterns.

check_query.description: Inspect URL query strings and parameters (snake_case alias).

checkHeaders.description: Optional list of HTTP request headers to inspect for path smuggling (e.g. X-Forwarded-Uri, X-Rewrite-URL, X-Original-URL).

check_headers.description: Optional list of HTTP request headers to inspect (snake_case alias).

checkBody.description: Inspect HTTP request bodies against checkBodyPatterns or blockPatterns.

checkBodyMaxBytes.description: Maximum number of request body bytes to buffer and inspect.

check_body_max_bytes.description: Maximum number of request body bytes to buffer and inspect (snake_case alias).

checkBodyPatterns.description: Optional list of regular expression patterns to match specifically against request body payloads.

check_body_patterns.description: Optional list of regular expression patterns for request body payloads (snake_case alias).

statusCode.description: Default HTTP status code when blocking a request.

status_code.description: Default HTTP status code when blocking a request (snake_case alias).

customResponseText.description: Custom response body text when blocking requests.

custom_response_text.description: Custom response body text when blocking requests (snake_case alias).

debug.description: Enable verbose inspection and candidate-path evaluation logs.

securityLog.description: Emit structured CrowdSec/SIEM-compatible JSON log events on every block event.

security_log.description: Emit structured JSON log events on every block event (snake_case alias).

allowedASNs.description: ASNs whose client addresses bypass HTTP inspection; requires asnDB.

allowed_asns.description: ASNs whose client addresses bypass HTTP inspection (snake_case alias).

blockedASNs.description: ASNs whose client addresses are strictly blocked from accessing any endpoints; requires asnDB.

blocked_asns.description: ASNs whose client addresses are strictly blocked (snake_case alias).

asnDB.description: Path to local JSON ASN-to-CIDR routing snapshot.

asn_db.description: Path to local JSON ASN-to-CIDR routing snapshot (snake_case alias).

botDefenseLevel.description: Preset bot defense tier enabling curated combinations of AI bot blocking, script client rejection, browser impersonation detection, and search engine verification.

blockAIBots.description: Block known AI training scrapers and automated LLM data harvesters.

block_ai_bots.description: Block known AI training scrapers and automated LLM data harvesters (snake_case alias).

aiBotProfile.description: AI bot blocking profile: train_only (allows citation search bots), search_only (blocks AI search citation scrapers), agents_only (blocks agentic AI scrapers/tools), all (blocks all AI bots), or aggressive (e.g. Bytespider).

blockUserAgents.description: Custom regular expressions of User-Agent headers to block.

block_user_agents.description: Custom regular expressions of User-Agent headers to block (snake_case alias).

allowUserAgents.description: Whitelisted User-Agent regular expressions that take precedence over blockUserAgents and AI bot rules.

honeypotTrapPaths.description: Hidden spider trap endpoints (e.g. /hidden-trap, /crawler-trap/) that instantly ban offending crawlers.

enableRobotsTxtHoneypot.description: Dynamically inject deterministic daily rotating Disallow honeypot trap entries into /robots.txt and ban scrapers that request them.

enable_robots_txt_honeypot.description: Dynamically inject deterministic daily rotating Disallow honeypot trap entries into /robots.txt (snake_case alias).

robotsTxtHoneypotSecret.description: Secret seed used to derive deterministic HMAC-SHA256 daily rotating honeypot tokens for robots.txt injection.

robots_txt_honeypot_secret.description: Secret seed used to derive deterministic HMAC-SHA256 daily rotating honeypot tokens (snake_case alias).

trapBanDuration.description: Sliding window duration to ban an IP after triggering a honeypot spider trap (e.g. 24h, 1h, 86400).

verifySearchEngineBots.description: Verify search engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot) via Forward-Confirmed Reverse DNS (FCrDNS) to detect and block spoofed scrapers.

verify_search_engine_bots.description: Verify search engine crawlers via FCrDNS (snake_case alias).

detectBrowserImpersonation.description: Detect and block automated bots impersonating modern desktop/mobile browsers by inspecting Client Hints and companion headers.

detect_browser_impersonation.description: Detect and block browser impersonators (snake_case alias).

blockScriptClients.description: Block requests from automated HTTP client libraries (e.g. python-requests, axios, Go-http-client) and headless scraping frameworks.

block_script_clients.description: Block requests from script clients and headless frameworks (snake_case alias).

explicitFields.description: List of configuration field names explicitly specified by the user to prevent preset wipeouts.

mode.description: Response action when a request is blocked.

status_code.description: HTTP status code to return (snake_case alias).

headers.description: Custom key-value HTTP headers sent with the blocked response.

redirect_url.description: Target URL when mode is 'redirect' (snake_case alias).

proxyUrl.description: Honeypot upstream backend URL when mode is 'proxy'.

proxy_url.description: Honeypot upstream backend URL when mode is 'proxy' (snake_case alias).

gzipBombMB.description: Decompressed size in megabytes for gzipBomb mode (supports decimal values, e.g. 0.5).

gzip_bomb_mb.description: Decompressed size in megabytes for gzipBomb mode (snake_case alias).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Retry-After header duration in seconds for rateLimitChallenge mode.

retry_after_seconds.description: Retry-After header duration in seconds (snake_case alias).

tarpitDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between bytes for tarpit mode.

tarpit_delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between bytes for tarpit mode (snake_case alias).

tarpitMaxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum connection duration in seconds for tarpit mode.

tarpit_max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum connection duration in seconds for tarpit mode (snake_case alias).

streamSizeMB.description: Maximum payload size in megabytes for infiniteStream mode.

stream_size_mb.description: Maximum payload size in megabytes for infiniteStream mode (snake_case alias).

siteKey.description: Public site key for the captcha widget.

site_key.description: Public site key for the captcha widget (snake_case alias).

title.description: HTML page title for the challenge page.

template.description: Custom Go HTML template string for the captcha page.
